cards.name: The Threshold
cards.message: You are standing at the edge of a room you have not entered.
cards.guidance: Not every door asks to be understood before it is walked through. Notice what you are waiting for permission to begin.

cards.name: Still Water
cards.message: What is muddy will clear if you stop stirring it.
cards.guidance: You do not have to solve this today. Let the sediment settle and look again tomorrow.

cards.name: The Ember
cards.message: Something small in you is still burning.
cards.guidance: It does not need to be a bonfire to be real. Protect it from the wind before you try to grow it.

cards.name: Open Hands
cards.message: You cannot receive with a closed fist.
cards.guidance: Consider what you are gripping. Some of it is not even yours to hold.

cards.name: The Long Root
cards.message: Growth you cannot see is still growth.
cards.guidance: The season below ground has no visible reward. It is not a delay; it is the work.

cards.name: The Mirror
cards.message: What irritates you is often instructive.
cards.guidance: The trait you cannot stand in someone else is asking to be looked at directly.

cards.name: Low Tide
cards.message: The water is not gone. It is gathering.
cards.guidance: Rest is not the interruption of the work. Today, it is the work.

cards.name: The Clearing
cards.message: You made space. Something will come.
cards.guidance: Resist filling it immediately. Emptiness is a decision you are allowed to keep.

cards.name: Borrowed Weight
cards.message: You are carrying something you did not pack.
cards.guidance: Set it down and see whose it was. You may find no one comes to claim it.

cards.name: First Light
cards.message: The beginning does not announce itself.
cards.guidance: It rarely feels like a beginning while it is happening. Look for the quiet ones.

cards.name: The Unsent Letter
cards.message: Say it, even if only to yourself.
cards.guidance: Some things need to be spoken to leave the body. The audience is optional.

cards.name: The Narrow Path
cards.message: Fewer options is not the same as fewer choices.
cards.guidance: When the way narrows, it is usually pointing. Follow it before you widen it again.

cards.name: Soft Animal
cards.message: Your body has been asking for something.
cards.guidance: It has probably been asking for a while. Today, answer it before it has to shout.

cards.name: The Old Story
cards.message: You are still telling it as though it is happening.
cards.guidance: Check whether the danger is present or remembered. They ask for different things.

cards.name: Wild Honey
cards.message: Take the sweetness without apologising for it.
cards.guidance: Pleasure is not a reward you must first earn. You are allowed it on an ordinary day.

cards.name: The Quiet No
cards.message: A refusal does not require a defence.
cards.guidance: You may decline without a case file. 'No' is a complete sentence and always has been.

cards.name: The Crossing
cards.message: You are further along than the fear suggests.
cards.guidance: Look behind you. The thing you were sure you could not survive is already back there.

cards.name: North
cards.message: You know the direction. You are negotiating the cost.
cards.guidance: Stop asking whether it is right. Start asking what you will trade for it.

cards.name: The Guest
cards.message: This feeling is visiting, not moving in.
cards.guidance: Give it tea. Do not give it your bedroom. It will leave when it has been received.

cards.name: Bare Branch
cards.message: What you have shed was not a loss.
cards.guidance: A tree in winter is not failing at being a tree. You are allowed a season of less.

cards.name: The Second Key
cards.message: There is another way in.
cards.guidance: The door you keep pushing may simply not be the entrance. Walk the perimeter.

cards.name: Held
cards.message: You do not have to be the only one carrying this.
cards.guidance: Name one person. Ask for one specific thing. That is the whole practice today.
